integrity_statement: An all-size argument using local threshold signatures, persistence, prefix decomposition and binomial convolution is supplied, along with finite reproducibility checks. Literature comparisons are not proof of priority; no external validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Classification concerns all continual constructive-neighbourhood frames on a fixed finite chain, not arbitrary posets or extensions with additional frame conditions.
Counts distinct ordered pairs of modal operations on the upset algebra rather than raw neighbourhood structures or syntactic formula classes.
The one-neighbourhood lower bound is for fixed-base semantic equivalence with all persistent valuations, not a bound on model worlds.
title: Two-neighbourhood compression and exact modal-operation census on finite Heyting chains
